title: Hobcaw Barony Nature Center

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Enjoy a rare opportunity to explore the creeks, islands, and historic landscapes of Hobcaw Barony on a small-group boat tour. Travel by bus to Hobcaw House pier, where the boat will depart with Captain Paul Kenny and Foundation staff. Participants will travel through Winyah Bay to North Inlet, discovering the salt marsh ecology, internationally recognized research, and rich coastal history of one of the best-understood estuaries in the world. Along the way, the boat passes North Island, where the Marquis de Lafayette landed in 1777, before continuing to the abandoned rice fields of Alderly Plantation. blurb: Hobcaw Barony is a privately owned research reserve located on the coast near Georgetown, South Carolina. Hobcaw Barony’s 16,000 acres encompass a rich diversity of every common ecosystem found on the South Carolina coast, making this an unparalleled site for research in the environmental sciences.
